rows.note: No Angela Prostamo in the family's export. A new name, and the only one in this sweep that is.

CANDIDATE, NOT A JOIN. The tree has an ANTONIO Giacomo Prostamo born 1934; the gazette prints ANTONINO Giacomo. Same distinctive middle name, same surname, right country, right decade. A gazette gives a name and a date and nothing else — no birth date, no address in this notice — so there is nothing here to disambiguate two men of one name with.

CANDIDATE. This archive already held «Maria Assunta's gazettal of 4 JULY 1966 at 3 Frank Street, Graceville», found incidentally through the web interface. This notice is dated 3 NOVEMBER 1966 and prints ASSUNTA without the Maria. Two dates four months apart for one woman is either two notices or two readings, and which it is has not been established here.
Not in the export under that compound name.
CANDIDATE. «Maria Polistena» is the commonest possible name in this family's towns and the archive holds more than one. Not attached.
MASCULINE. The export holds a «Nunziatta Polistena», feminine, and these are not the same name. Recorded as a separate person until an act says otherwise.
CANDIDATE. The tree's Francesco Melluso was born in 1901 and would be sixty at this gazettal, which fits a post-war migrant naturalising. Nothing in the notice tests it.
